hero.title: Fresh Fruit, Delivered To Your Door
hero.text: A simple, seasonal selection of fruit picked at peak ripeness and delivered weekly.

content.content: A few of the varieties that show up most often in our boxes.
Crisp, sweet, and a little tart. A fall favorite.
Hand-picked and never held in cold storage long.
Easy to peel, seedless, and juicy through winter.
Fragrant and soft-ripe, best eaten the day it arrives.
What comes standard with a subscription, and what doesn't.
Only what's actually ripe right now.
Grown within a day's drive of your door.
A new box shows up on the same day each week.
A few ideas for using everything before it turns.
We let the orchard do that part.
Fruit is harvested only after it reaches full ripeness, then packed the same day.
Small batches, picked a few times a week rather than all at once.
From tree to box to door, usually within 48 hours.
A few of the people behind what ends up in your box.
The peaches this month were some of the best I've had, and everything arrived cold.
I like that the box changes with the season instead of the same fruit every week.
The recipe cards actually get used in our house, which is rare.
Delivery has been on time every single week since we signed up.
Can I choose what's in my box?
Boxes are curated by what's ripe, but you can flag fruit you'd rather skip.
Let us know within 48 hours and we'll replace it in the next box.
Can I pause or cancel anytime?
Yes, there's no minimum commitment and no cancellation fee.
Where does the fruit come from?
Small orchards and farms within a day's drive of our packing house.
